_note: Words for the Contacts page, contact import and the address suggestions. Edit the wording here. {count}, {date} and {file} are filled in by the app.
title: Contacts
intro: Everyone you've emailed appears here on their own. Add people, give them a name, or remove anyone you don't want.
introSavedOnly: Only the contacts you've added yourself appear here, because adding people from your emails is switched off in Settings.
none: No contacts yet. Anyone you email will appear here, or press Add contact or Import.
name: Name
invalid: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
failed: That didn't save. Please try again.
importIntro: Bring your contacts across from Gmail, iPhone or Outlook. Save them as a file there, then choose the file here. Nothing is added until you check the list and press Add.
importAlreadyCount: {count} already in your contacts will be skipped.
importAlreadyOne: 1 already in your contacts will be skipped.
importNothingNew: Everyone in this file is already in your contacts, so there's nothing to add.
importNone: We couldn't find any email addresses in that file. Choose a .vcf or .csv file saved from your contacts.
importTooBig: That file is too big. Choose a contacts file under 10 MB.
importUnreadable: We couldn't read that file. Choose a .vcf or .csv file saved from your contacts.
importFailed: Some contacts didn't save. Please try again; anyone already added will be skipped.
importHelp: How do I save my contacts as a file?
importHelpGmail: Gmail: on a computer, go to contacts.google.com. Tick one contact, then the box at the top to select all. Press the three dots, choose Export, pick vCard and press Export.
importHelpIphone: iPhone: your contacts need to be in iCloud (on your iPhone, Settings, your name, iCloud, then switch on Contacts). Then on a computer, go to icloud.com/contacts, select all contacts, press the three dots and choose Export vCard.
importHelpOutlook: Outlook: go to outlook.com and open People. Choose Manage contacts, then Export contacts, pick All contacts and press Export.
pickOne: Choose someone on the left to see their details and your recent emails with them.
noRecent: No emails with this person yet.
